SandSea.findings: Inspected current wide and close views. Orange bare sand carries small ripples and modest rolling dune relief with sparse xeric shrubs; active sand has no rooted grass lawn. Overhead summer lighting makes broad ridge shading subtle.

GravelDesert.findings: Inspected current wide and close views. Fine gravel pavement, scattered coarse rocks and sparse scrub are distinct from orange mobile sand and clay-pan ground; distant microscopic texture retires through the existing range controls.

ClayPan.findings: Inspected current wide and close views. Flat fine brown substrate has polygonal drying cracks near the observer, sparse scrub and few coarse stones. It remains distinct from gravel pavement and mobile sand.

FreshwaterMarsh.findings: Inspected current wide and close views. Open sedge/rush ground has several enclosed pools and sparse tree islands, visibly distinct from the wooded wetland. Actual scatter contains 20 submerged reed plants; the sample forest potential is 0.0021.

WoodedSwamp.findings: Inspected current wide and close game-camera views. A real shallow pond sits inside retained woodland rather than replacing it with an open lawn. The bank sample retains 0.499 forest potential and four nearby pools; actual scatter includes 36 reed plants rooted in water. Existing tree artwork is unchanged in this landscape checkpoint.

Peatland.findings: Inspected current wide and close views. Low moss/sedge ground and scattered dwarf/woody islands surround a shallow-pool mosaic; the sample has 0.893 peat control, 0.35 moss weight and five nearby pools. No unsupported global forest replacement is inferred.

pond.findings: Inspected current wide and close views. The actual 14.6m-radius pond is enclosed by a depressed bed and dry bank with no disconnected water triangles or crossing planes visible. Water has surface ripples and the drinking/swimming paths use the same 1.71m-deep basin.

SaltFlat.findings: Inspected current wide and close views. Pale crust with fine drying cracks and very sparse coarse stones, with a vegetated margin rather than a broad grass lawn over the flat. No visible tile-border gap or elevated crossing water plane.

LimestoneUpland.findings: Inspected loaded wide and close views. Dissected upland with exposed substrate on steep slopes, soil-bearing vegetated gullies and varied sparse woodland. No tile gaps, floating vegetation or newly claimed cave/waterfall landmark implementation.

GlacialLowland.findings: Inspected current wide and close views. Exposed low-relief ground with scattered coarse stones and short patchy moss/lichen and graminoids, with no forest canopy. Distinct from the tall marsh sward and wooded wetlands; no active ice cover is claimed by this exposed-ground label.
